answer: Proof of stake remains a primary defense against Sybil attacks, functioning as an economic ember that incinerates the capital of malicious actors attempting to flood the network with fake identities. By requiring nodes to lock value to influence the collective knoll of consensus, the cost of an attack scales linearly with asset acquisition. This barrier acts as a financial inlet, ensuring that only agents with skin in the game can participate, thereby rendering identity multiplication prohibitively expensive.
